card.name: Replies to commenters on a fossil-dig page
card.fires_on: The greeting and first words of a staff reply to a named commenter in a web comment thread, such as "Hi Justin, thanks" or "Hi Alexander -". It responds on the name, the punctuation after it, and the thanks.

modes.label: Name after Hi
modes.description: The commenter's first name (or part of it) right after "Hi" at the start of a reply.
modes.example: Hi<< Justin>>, thanks for the enquiry.

modes.label: Thanks opening
modes.description: The thanks wording or the punctuation just after the name in the reply's opening line.
modes.example: Hi Justin,<< thanks>> for the enquiry.

card.plain: It lights up in the opening line of a friendly reply to a named person who left a comment on a fossil-dig website.
